summary.text: Dave Baker is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has served in the House since 2015, currently representing District 16B, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He co-chairs the House Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dave Baker has served in the Minnesota House of Representatives since 2015 and has represented District 16B since January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, Ways and Means, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees, and he co-chaired the last of these.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
